selection_rule: top-12 signatures per op by real-traffic call count, plus the smallest and largest input footprint, plus one signature per capture group; warmup-only signatures excluded

capture_modifiers: --disable-cuda-graph (python-level ops are invisible inside a captured graph)

tensors phase adds --disable-radix-cache (radix cache rewrites mamba/state pool rows outside the kernel call and breaks the state chain; shapes phase keeps radix ON so prefix-hit-driven chunk lengths stay realistic)
workload_sources: benchmark/gsm8k/bench_sglang.py (real GSM8K, 2/5/16-shot, incl. a 200-question accuracy run)
